notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello! This update fixed a critical bug that caused the game to crash... (when entering the cave on level 9).

The work of saving the game has also been fixed, since it previously did not work correctly.

Additionally, the features of the main character control have been changed in the game!
[list]
[*] Now you can use "SPACE"/"W" to jump;
[*] The player can now look down, regardless of whether he is on the ground or not.
[/list]
